content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2065449999 - inference-runtime.us-central-1: p99 tail latency spike + increased kv-cache miss-rate after canary enable of quantized-2.0. Paging oncall.

leah: ack. I'm oncall. Seeing p99 jump ~900ms at 15:07 UTC, sustained for ~6m. Error budget alerts tripped for hosted tenants. Starting immediate mitigation runbook.

sam: quick triage notes: we rolled quantized-2.0 to 5% canary at 14:50 UTC with batching-shim v0.9. Observed KV rehydration churn and a slow downlock in async kv reads. Suspect interaction between batching-shim and new quant code path.

devon: pushing temporary mitigation: remove canary traffic from quantized-2.0, force canary->baseline. Also set batching window smaller for affected pools to reduce rekey contention.

devon: ```
# remove canary assignment
rb traffic update --service=inference-runtime --region=us-central-1 --canary=0
# reduce batching window
rb config set --pool=us-central-3 --batch_window_ms=10
# kick kv rehydration
rb kv flush --scope=local_prefix --pool=us-central-3
```

leah: noted. Initiating customer impact sweep. Early list: finance-reporting (high long-context use) and concierge-bot tenants. Support please surface high-priority customers.

support-bot: Ops ticket SUP-7920 created; threads opened in #support-finance-reporting and #support-concierge. Customer-facing note posted: "We're investigating increased tail latency and inconsistencies for long-context streams in us-central-1. Engineers are mitigating now."

oncall-l1: taking live ops from leah in 4. Handoff: sam's triage, devon's mitigations in flight, watch for p99 stabilization and kv.miss_rate.

sam: reproduction steps documented in RH-4920. Short repro: stream 1000-token context with intermittent parallel requests -> kv key churn + stale kv reads when batching-shim combines windows across quant paths.

sre: adding that autoscaler reacted to latency and scaled up nodes which made the cache cold starts worse. Classic scale-churn feedback loop.

devon: after mitigation p99 decreased to ~120ms from 900ms, kv miss-rate back to baseline. Monitoring for 30m.

leah: ok, switching thread focus to post-incident actions. We should schedule a postmortem and assign remediation tasks.

oncall-l1: proposed postmortem slot: 2065465000 (placeholder) - aiming 24h from now 15:00 UTC. Invite: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, product, support. I'll send calendar.

sam: preliminary root cause: batching-shim was combining requests across quant path boundary causing inconsistent kv key derivation; combined with soft-eviction heuristic in kv (changed in cf3a7) produced stale key rehydration. When autoscaler added nodes cold-read pressure amplified the problem.

devon: created tracking tickets:
- RH-4920: reproduce + unit test (owner: sam, due: 7d)
- RH-4921: kv soft-eviction rollback plan + canary gating (owner: devon, due: 2w)
- RH-4922: batching-shim canary constraint to avoid cross-quant-window merges (owner: leah, due: 1w)
- SUP-7920: customer communications and runbook updates (owner: support, due: 3d)

leah: action items now (short list):
- AH1: Add regression test for kv-key derivation across quant paths (owner: sam, RH-4920, due: 1w)
- AH2: Add pre-rollout canary checks: kv.miss_rate, kv.rehydration_rate, batch.eviction_churn (owner: leah, RH-4921, due: 2w)
- AH3: Autoscaler safety: implement ramp throttle and suppress scale-up on kv.miss_rate spike (owner: oncall-l1, RH-4923, due: 3w)
- AH4: Update rollout playbook to block simultaneous quant toggle + batching-shim toggles (owner: leah, RH-4922, due: 1w)
- AH5: Customer follow-up package for impacted tenants (owner: support, SUP-7920, due: 48h)

oncall-l2: I'll take owner for RH-4923 and add temporary suppress rule in autoscaler to prevent oscillation while we fix root cause. Will document change and link.

sre: metric proposals to add to rollout dashboard: 'kv.rehydration_rate', 'kv.miss_rate_5m', 'batch.window_merge_count', 'autoscaler.scale_oscillation_index'. Recommend canary gate thresholds.

devon: small note: we should not only flush prefixes during mitigation; we should ensure in-flight generation contexts are drained cleanly to avoid partial kv state leading to stale emissions. Add drain-and-wait step to runbooks.

leah: agreed. Add to postmortem agenda: timeline, root cause, reproduce, monitoring & alerting gaps, rollout guardrails, customer comms, follow-ups with owners/due dates.

support-bot: SUP-7920 updated: mitigation applied, customers notified, postmortem pending. Will coordinate replies to tickets and attach timeline after postmortem.

sam: I'll push the minimal repro and a failing unit test to RH-4920 by EOD and add CI job to run it on PRs that touch kv, batching, or quant selection.

devon: also proposing we add a simple compatibility check in the runtime: when enabling new quant variant, assert kv key derivation mapping matches baseline for a sample of long-context traces before rolling.

leah: good. I'll draft the postmortem doc and link tickets + action items. Assigning severity: Sev2 (multiple customers impacted, quick rollback mitigated, no data loss). I'll ping folks with the meeting invite shortly.

oncall-l1: closing the live mitigation loop here. Monitoring green for 20m. If stable, we'll mark incident as mitigated and move to postmortem tracking.

incident-bot: Incident 2065449999 status updated: MITIGATED. Postmortem scheduled: placeholder 2065465000. Linked tickets: RH-4920, RH-4921, RH-4922, RH-4923, SUP-7920.

leah: thanks team. We'll reconvene in the postmortem to confirm fixes and close action items. If anyone wants edit access to the draft doc ping me.

support-bot: SUP-7920 will include customer timeline and remediation ETA once RH tickets have owners update.
